data.title: 泥岩 · 重铠褪尽后的温软素颜
data.action: 席地坐在毛毯上，双手环膝，两根弯曲的大角泛着温润石质光泽，白发遮着绯红脸颊，赤红双眸满是脱去重铠后的羞涩。
data.location: 罗德岛重装干员整备库角落，庞大厚重的全身动力装甲安放在背景阴影中
data.lighting: 暖橙色地脚工作灯自下而上照射，柔和化解了机械库的冰冷，为白发披上蜜色光芒
data.mood: 惊人反差的极度娇柔，粗粝战具与柔弱美人的强烈对照
data.description: 罗德岛重装干员整备库角落，庞大厚重的全身动力装甲安放在背景阴影中。席地坐在毛毯上，双手环膝，两根弯曲的大角泛着温润石质光泽，白发遮着绯红脸颊，赤红双眸满是脱去重铠后的羞涩。 她微微抬眸轻语——“脱下那身装甲后……站在你面前的我，是不是显得格外单薄软弱？请别移开视线……博士。”
data.promptProse: Sitting on a wool blanket inside a quiet corner of Rhodes Island's maintenance bay at night, Mudrock hugs her knees in a basalt-black breathable mesh bralette with side lacing and low-rise boyshorts. With her towering powered armor and war hammer resting silently behind her, she looks up with a shy, unmasked blush under low amber lamp light.
data.animaCaption: Seated on a thick wool blanket hugging her knees in a black mesh strappy bralette and boyshorts, she peeks past her hair with a shy post-battle blush. A low amber floor lamp warms her face against the dark silhouette of her resting armor and hammer.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a fitted basalt-black breathable mesh bralette with industrial side-rib lacing and matching low-rise black boyshorts.
